filtrationMethods.maintenance: Clean quartz sleeve, replace bulb annually

catchmentSystem.formula: 1 inch of rain on a 1,000 sq ft roof yields ~623 gallons.

components.name: Roof Surface
components.desc: Metal roofing preferred (cleanest runoff). Avoid asphalt shingles due to toxic chemicals.

components.name: Gutters & Guards
components.desc: Wide gutters with leaf screens to block leaves, pine needles, and large debris.

components.name: First Flush Diverter
components.desc: Diverts the first 10-20 gallons of dirtier initial rain runoff containing bird droppings/dust.

components.name: Cistern/Barrels
components.desc: Food-grade, opaque storage tanks. Keep out of direct sun to prevent algae growth.
